items.source: Each individual test constructor parameter will only be autowired if it is annotated with @Autowired, @Qualifier, or @Value, or if the constructor itself is annotated with @Autowired or @jakarta.inject.Inject.
items.translation: 每个单独的测试构造函数参数仅在其上标注了 @Autowired、 @Qualifier 或 @Value， 或者如果构造函数本身标注了 @Autowired 或 @jakarta.inject.Inject 时才会被自动注入。

items.source: All test constructor parameters will be autowired as if the constructor itself were annotated with @Autowired or @jakarta.inject.Inject.
items.translation: 所有测试构造函数参数都将自动注入，就好像该构造函数本身被标注了 `@Autowired` 或 `@jakarta.inject.Inject` 一样。

items.source: Get the AutowireMode enum constant with the supplied name, ignoring case.
items.translation: 获取具有指定名称的AutowireMode枚举常量，忽略大小写。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Defines autowiring modes for parameters in a test constructor.
items.translation: 定义测试构造函数中参数的自动装配模式。
